C0_available_training_audit.reason: seed_progress stores each C0 selected epoch and three inner best epochs, but not inner executed epochs, validation losses, fitted parameter vectors, or train predictions; predictions_partial.npz contains only complex OOF C0/C1 arrays.

G0_checkpoint_load_audit.format: flattened float32 final_parameters array stored by direct model.parameters() iteration order; no optimizer state/checkpoint history saved

actual_loss: mean(((prediction-target)/maximum(std(target, axis=0),1e-12))**2); scale divides only, no target-mean subtraction; weight decay is optimizer-only, not included in reported loss.
input_scaler: M5 Xform StandardScaler.fit(geometry/130); scaler fitted on outer train in frozen runners; G0 adds fixed physical positions divided by 1740 nm and keeps six positions ordered.
limits: Prior fold-local PCA/scaler objects were not serialized; this audit reconstructs the deterministic same fit using only the matching outer-train rows and checks saved variance-ratio metadata.
No C0 parameter tensor, optimizer state, outer final train loss, or epoch curves are stored, so those quantities cannot be recovered without a prohibited C0 LOGO refit.
Static source checks show implementation wiring, but do not prove generalization or physical fidelity.

optimizer_audit.both: AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.002, weight_decay=0.0001); all model parameters are passed through parameters(); loss.backward(); clip_grad_norm_(...,5.0); optimizer.step(); training loss measured before update in each loop body; validation evaluated after update in eval/no_grad mode.
optimizer_audit.detach_audit: No detach/no_grad is present between model forward and training loss/backward in the fit functions; no known broken gradient path from source.
optimizer_audit.validation: inner validation is model.eval plus no_grad; final refit is model.train each step then final outputs/loss measured after the last update in eval/no_grad.

selection_audit.C0_refit_train_loss: not saved by the frozen run
selection_audit.G0_refit_train_loss: computed after the final update from the final checkpoint outputs
selection_audit.inner_best_epoch: validation standardized latent MSE is computed after each optimizer update
selection_audit.outer_refit: reset deterministic initialization, then train on all outer-train rows for integer median of the three inner best epochs

target: one rank-2 Cartesian PCA fit independently for each of seven orders; order slots [-3..3], two scores/order; scores are not whitened or standardized by PCA.
